items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: He was good, Johnny. I know him just like this. Him and the little one both used to work at Mintus Bag Factory.

ctx.x: How did Dodd sound in those days on clarinet? When you first heard him, was he any good? Was he playing pretty good or?
Oh, yeah, yeah. He all was good. He was good, Johnny. I know him just like this. Him and the little one both used to work at Mintus Bag Factory.
Yeah, I didn't know the older brother worked there. I knew Baby did, yeah.
